sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
Having discovered a secret chamber, the heroes find notes and artifacts left by the famous French hero [[Joan of Arc]]. Joan’s notes point them to the mysterious [[Paris Catacombs|catacombs]] under Paris, where a powerful [[Ring of Arc|magic ring]] is hidden. The heroes, [[Dante Vale]], [[Zhalia Moon]], [[Lok Lambert]], and [[Sophie Casterwill]] find a hidden entrance to the catacombs within an [[abandoned church in Paris]], but [[DeFoe]] and his [[Suits]] show up sent by the evil [[The Professor|Professor]].

Dante battles the Suits to give his friends time to figure out how to open the secret door. They manage to get in and collapse the entrance before the Suits can follow. Lok gets caught in a trap but manages to find a way out. In the process, he discovers a new [[Titan]] named [[Springer]]. The heroes get the Ring of Arc. But it is cursed, and it knocks Lok unconscious with horrible visions of the future. Suits are on the way to capture them and to take the [[Ring of Arc]].

full_text:
Rouen, France

Dante receives from Guggenheim a new mission for the Huntik Foundation. The Huntik team has to unveil the myth of the Cave of the Gargoyle by the Seine River. Zhalia frees Peter, a guide from the Foundation who has been put in jail by the Organization.

French Catacombs

DeFoe manages to sieze the Titan, Gar-Ghoul, but Lok finds an important secret passage.

== Synopsis ==
The mystery of Joan of Arc being a former Seeker leads the gang to Notre Dame where a stone gargoyle holds the key to the hidden catacombs entrance and to more Titans.

== Plot ==
Having discovered a secret chamber, the heroes find notes and artifacts left by the famous French hero Joan of Arc. Joan’s notes point them to the mysterious catacombs under Paris, where a powerful magic ring is hidden. The heroes, Dante Vale, Zhalia Moon, Lok Lambert, and Sophie Casterwill find a hidden entrance to the catacombs within an abandoned church in Paris, but DeFoe and his Suits show up sent by the evil Professor.

Dante battles the Suits to give his friends time to figure out how to open the secret door. They manage to get in and collapse the entrance before the Suits can follow. Lok gets caught in a trap but manages to find a way out. In the process, he discovers a new Titan named Springer. The heroes get the Ring of Arc. But it is cursed, and it knocks Lok unconscious with horrible visions of the future. Suits are on the way to capture them and to take the Ring of Arc.

== Trivia ==
* The episode features foreshadowing: When passing through another mirror trap in the Paris Catacombs, it is stated in Joan of Arc's notes that only the pure of heart can pass. Lok, Dante, and Sophie pass unchallenged but when Zhalia attempts to pass there is a cave in.
